sections.title: 1. Active Roster & 14-Starter Lineup Format
sections.body: 26 active roster spots + 4 IR spots. Starting 14-man lineup: 1 QB, 2 RB, 2 WR, 1 TE, 2 FLEX (RB/WR/TE), 1 K, 1 D/ST, 1 DL, 1 LB, 1 DB, and 1 DP (Defensive Flex).

sections.title: 2. 12 Invisible Keepers & 14-Round Post-Keeper Snake Draft
sections.body: Each franchise locks up to 12 keepers 72 hours prior to the draft. Positional Keeper Caps: Max 4 RBs, Max 4 WRs, and Max 3 of any single other position (QB, TE, DL, LB, DB, K, D/ST). Keepers occupy ESPN Rounds 1–12 invisibly; the live draft board spans App Rounds 1–14 (ESPN Rounds 13–26).

sections.title: 3. 72-Hour Pre-Draft Lock Window & Pick-Only Trading
sections.body: During the 72-hour window between Keeper Lock and Draft Night, player trades are frozen. Draft-pick-only trades remain legal until the draft begins. Full player + pick trading reopens once the draft is finalized.

sections.title: 4. 6-Team Playoff Bracket, Byes & Official Tiebreakers
sections.body: 6 teams qualify for the championship playoffs (Seeds 1 & 2 earn First-Round Byes). Official Seeding Tiebreaker Order: (1) Overall Win-Loss-Tie Record -> (2) Divisional Record (if applicable) -> (3) Total Points For (PF) -> (4) Head-to-Head (H2H) Record.

sections.title: 5. Draft Order Rules & Toilet Bowl / Phallic Feaster
sections.body: Slots 1–5 (Non-Playoff Teams) are ordered by Reverse Regular Season Standings (10th place picks 1.01; 6th place picks 1.05). Slots 6–10 (Playoff Teams) are ordered by Reverse Postseason Finish (League Champion picks 1.10; Runner-Up picks 1.09). The Toilet Bowl loser is crowned the Phallic Feaster (league champion renames their team).

sections.title: 6. $150 Entry Fee, Win-Docking & $600 FAAB Budget
sections.body: Annual league dues are $150 per manager, tracked by Leo (Central Banker). Dues must be paid within 1 month after the draft; unpaid teams are docked 1 Win per week overdue. Each team receives a $600 annual FAAB waiver budget.
